scope: Constraint counts with unchanged Poseidon1 parameters
design: Bind each use to its exact subject
Keep own and curator authentication separate
Reuse amount checks and withdrawal padding
experiments: Separate participant and asset trees under a domain-separated header
Bind rule activity, subject and guard classes to a static circuit plan
limits: The 30 percent minimum does not hold for every shape
The 70 percent largest circuit target is unmet
V3 circuits and wire adapters are not registered with production keys
Forest and outlined counts require new circuit keys and protocol integration
Forest full transaction counts are compilation results without a full transaction witness or proof
Static rule plans support only the classes bound to each plan
The mixed16 plan includes scalar owner guards and requires one active payment asset
Asset tree height limits the full registry asset count, not only the assets in one transaction
Height 1 permits three asset records and a sentinel, height 5 permits 1023 asset records and a sentinel
Participant height 10 permits 1048575 participant records and a sentinel
The 19 asset case includes 16 zero amount output assets and three public assets
Transaction bytes and account feasibility were not tested for the zero amount extreme
